title: Test Movie: Ruffle warns about unknown device fonts (Noto Sans, AppleGothic)
description:
After Control → Test Movie on Magnet.fla, the Ruffle Output tab shows repeated warnings:
- '%cWARN%c core/src/library.rs:559%c Unknown device font "Noto Sans" (bold: true, italic: false)'
- '%cWARN%c core/src/library.rs:559%c Unknown device font "AppleGothic" (bold: true, italic: false)'

The warnings include raw CSS format strings ('%c') appearing as literal text in the Output panel rather than being parsed as styled console output.

Two issues:
1. The SWF references device fonts (Noto Sans, AppleGothic) that Ruffle cannot find — these fonts are specified in the FLA's text objects but not embedded. Text fields using these fonts will fall back to a substitute.
2. The Output tab renders Ruffle's console.warn format strings literally ('%cWARN%c ...color: orange...') instead of filtering/formatting them. Expected: either strip the CSS format args or render them as styled text.
